courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 淡江大橋工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」與「1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；淡江大橋工程的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "How back stays cut bending in an asymmetric pylon" and "Observing rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Danjiang Bridge Engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦建築造型主導的單塔不對稱斜張橋：彎折鋼塔、背索、開合橋與通車後的斜索雨風振動；淡江大橋工程則以以背跨錨固、縱向消能、索力與疲勞量化淡江大橋 450 m 單塔不對稱斜張橋的設計與驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on an architecture-led single-pylon asymmetric bridge: bent steel pylon, back stays, bascule span and post-opening rain–wind stay vibration; Danjiang Bridge Engineering centres on quantifying back-span anchorage, longitudinal energy dissipation, stay forces and fatigue for the 450 m single-pylon asymmetric Danjiang Bridge, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「139 m 彎折鋼塔」與「背跨錨墩拉力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到淡江大橋工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「風洞試驗與渦致振動判讀」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “139 m bent steel pylon” and “Back-span anchor-pier force”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Danjiang Bridge Engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 伊拉斯謨大橋
history.text: 伊拉斯謨大橋為連接鹿特丹市中心與南岸新開發的 Kop van Zuid 而建，主要目標是成為城市地標。建築師 Ben van Berkel 在 1990 年提出受阿拉米略橋啟發的構想，經工程可行性修改為 139 m 鋼塔加背索，市議會於 1991 年 11 月確定塔形；大部分經費來自荷蘭經濟結構強化基金。工程於 1993 年 9 月 1 日開工，1996 年 9 月由女王碧雅翠絲正式啟用，工期約 3 年又 3 天、實際成本略低於預算。通車後的雨風振動與後來加裝的調諧液壓阻尼器，使它成為斜索防振的重要案例。本課只重建公開工程原理，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: The Erasmus Bridge was built to link central Rotterdam with the newly developed Kop van Zuid on the south bank, primarily as a city landmark. Architect Ben van Berkel proposed an Alamillo-inspired concept in 1990, which engineering feasibility reworked into a 139 m steel pylon with back stays, and the city council fixed the pylon form in November 1991; most funding came from the Dutch economic structure fund. Construction began on 1 September 1993 and Queen Beatrix opened the bridge in September 1996, about 3 years and 3 days later, with realised cost slightly below budget. Rain–wind vibration after opening and the tuned hydraulic dampers fitted later made it a key case in stay vibration control. This course reconstructs public engineering principles only and represents no design document.

history.text: 本課把「背索如何降低不對稱塔的彎矩」到「開合橋機電、運轉紀錄與營運交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
